TCP provides reliable data transfer, while UDP is faster but less reliable.

Protocols are rules that enable devices to communicate and exchange data. TCP/IP is the fundamental suite of protocols used for internet communication: TCP provides reliable data transfer, while IP handles addressing and routing packets. HTTP is used to transfer web pages and other web data between browsers and web servers. DNS translates domain names into IP addresses, and DHCP automatically assigns IP addresses to devices.
